candidates.name: Upper Marie Joseph Lake
candidates.reason: No matching modern complete outer basin established. Polygon search omits some river-bank classes; absence of a polygon is not evidence of absence. No whole-basin centroid adopted.

candidates.name: Northern Loch Lomond / Lake Uist search
candidates.reason: LOCH LOMOND label denotes locality context and does not establish the lake identity. Northern large basin and connecting waterways were not measured. Selected modern rings were verified finite and valid after a generic search-guide intersection warning; that warning was not used to delete observations.

candidates.name: McIntyre Lake whole basin
candidates.reason: Mills label obscures the northern shore; whole-basin centroid withheld. R31 measures the visible western lake-stream junction instead.

candidates.name: Northern extension coverage
